PROSE.rule: Old Prose routes are stale and non-dispatchable. Any genuinely open integration result is an ordinary BOOK obligation.

PROGRAMMING.rule: Programming engineering/product work is not dispatchable as peer work before explicit admission.

owner_discovery_rule: Controllers enumerate owner_files as execution-ready lanes and compare its keys against Topology 006 execution_readiness.execution_ready_peer_system_ids on every run. Architectural peer admission alone never creates a Second Shift lane.
job_lock_rule: Before dispatch every delegation must conform to current topology, execution readiness, program job lock and completion status. Cross-lane work, false readiness, retired-system resurrection, unauthorized user side effects or false completion must not dispatch.
system_lane_rule: The execution-ready peer worker lanes are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE remain admitted architectural peers but have no Second Shift lane until their canonical control records and execution readiness are established. PROSE is terminally retired. Programming remains a named non-peer work program until explicit admission.
portfolio_rule: The controller reads CURRENT-AUTHORITY, selected topology, execution readiness, job lock, completion status, current obligation registry, repair state, every active owner file and live owner control before dispatch.
night_start_rule: Freshly re-read CURRENT-AUTHORITY, selected topology, execution readiness, job lock, completion status, obligation registry, repair state and owner control bindings before execution; never trust stale snapshots.
dispatch_rule: Dispatch only job-conforming READY/CANDIDATE work in execution-ready peer lanes. READY obligations owned by admitted-but-not-execution-ready peers remain non-dispatchable until readiness authority changes. User-authorized external actions remain subject to explicit action authority.
claim_rule: Only one mutation-capable claim/lease may be live per execution-ready owner lane. Admitted-but-not-execution-ready peers and PROSE have no claim domain. Programming has no peer claim domain before topology admission.
retry_rule: Transient dependencies receive finite classified retries; after exhaustion select independent safe work within the same execution-ready owner job.
stale_rule: No job survives a live-head, current-obligation, job-lock, topology, execution-readiness, completion-status or retired-system mismatch.
no_work_rule: An execution-ready peer lane may be idle only after durable all-eight-rungs exhaustion for its own locked job. Admitted-but-not-execution-ready peers and retired systems require no active lane or exhaustion proof.
successor_rule: After completion/material block, re-read live authority and select the next dependency-valid successor inside the same execution-ready lane job. Never bind a Prose successor and never activate a non-ready peer by successor selection.
utilization_rule: Active peer ledgers are exactly the four execution-ready owner_files lanes. SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE emit no Second Shift telemetry until execution readiness. Book-owned preserved-Prose integration is BOOK telemetry only. Programming product work has no peer utilization ledger before admission.
